Notes: Full bīja explicitly gives Nepali biu seed, Kumaoni bĩyo/biyõ and regional bīa/bīyā seed. These directly support Majhi/Bote bʸu seed as a glide-bearing reduced regional form. The separately compounded bījadhāna/bījadhānya seed-corn entries were inspected and are not substituted. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.
